name: Pennsylvania Dental Group
description: Pennsylvania Dental Group sees students, faculty, and neighbors around Market Street. Come in for a cleaning, a crown, or a problem that will not wait.

story.heading: A city practice with a steady hand
paragraphs: You should not need a map to find the dentist. We keep the phone, the address, and the reason to visit in one place.
Tell us what hurts, what you want to protect, and how soon you can come in. We will meet you there.
Pennsylvania Dental Group serves people who live and work in Philadelphia.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.

spotlight.heading: 3700 Market Street
